notes: MIDI scheme from the Makin User Manual 2023 (Rydal/Thirlmere/Windermere/Derwent): default channels as set here, stops on channel 12, CC7 general volume 40-127, CC11 swell pedal 55-127, all-stops-off SysEx F0 00 4A 4F 48 41 53 7F F7 sent from MIDI SEQ when Cancel is pressed.
Stops are sent as toggling Program Changes on channel 12, but no per-stop Program Change table is published for this model, so every stop is left unbound: use Learn every stop.

The channel of the CC11 expression message is not stated in the manual; it is assumed to be the channel of the division the pedal controls. Master volume (CC7) is assumed on channel 1. Check on your organ; channel numbers can also be changed in the organ's MIDI menu.
'Great & Pedal Combinations Coupled', 'General on Swell Toe Pistons' and similar piston/transfer controls are console functions, not stops, and are not listed.

Covers both the Windermere 3-53T (tabstop) and 3-53D (drawstop). The 'Great Reeds on Choir' transfer is not a stop and is not listed. The Choir solo reeds (Solo Trumpet, Tuba) can be customised in the organ menu. The Choir expression channel (choir=1) is assumed, like the Swell's.
Stop list: https://www.makinorgans.co.uk/organs/windermere-organs/windermere-3-53t (manufacturer specification page; the 3-53D has the same stop list)
